- `web/src/hooks/useMemoQueries.ts` (useCreateMemo hook)

- `store/db/sqlite/memo.go` (DB.CreateMemo — SQL INSERT)

**q25.** CEL (Common Expression Language) via `github.com/google/cel-go`; engine at `internal/filter/engine.go`. CEL expressions are compiled into a dialect-agnostic condition IR (`internal/filter/parser.go` / `ir.go`), then rendered to dialect-specific SQL (`internal/filter/render.go`). Each driver calls `filter.AppendConditions` with its dialect constant (DialectSQLite/DialectPostgres/DialectMySQL), which handles placeholder style, JSON operators, LIKE/ILIKE, date extraction, etc. per dialect.

**q26.** memo, memo_relation, attachment, memo_share (via ON DELETE CASCADE FK on `memo_share.memo_id`), plus comment memos (recursively deleted first, each triggering its own cascade of memo_relation and attachment cleanup)

**q27.** Go `embed.FS` (`//go:embed dist/*`) with Echo static middleware and SPA fallback; wired in `server/router/frontend/frontend.go`

**q28.**
- S3 Presign Runner — 12-hour `time.Ticker` (`server/runner/s3presign/runner.go`, started in `server/server.go`:162-169)
- Webhook async workers — 4 goroutines draining a buffered channel, started via package `init()` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go`
- Unused infra: the `memopayload` runner (`server/runner/memopayload/runner.go`) has a `RunOnce` batch method but is never started as a background worker by the server; its `RebuildMemoPayload` function is only called inline/synchronously from `memo_service.go`

**q29.** Interceptor: `web/src/connect.ts` (authInterceptor, line 156); token kinds: JWT access tokens (short-lived, 15 min), JWT refresh tokens (30-day, cookie-based), and Personal Access Tokens (PAT, `memos_pat_` prefix); backend validation package: `server/auth`

**q30.**
- memo created: DispatchMemoCreatedWebhook (`memo_service_webhooks.go`:15)
- memo updated: DispatchMemoUpdatedWebhook (`memo_service_webhooks.go`:20)
- memo deleted: DispatchMemoDeletedWebhook (`memo_service_webhooks.go`:25)
- comment created: DispatchMemoCommentCreatedWebhook (`memo_service_webhooks.go`:30)
- All converge on: `webhook.PostAsync` in `internal/webhook/webhook.go` (the first three via shared `dispatchMemoRelatedWebhook` at line 48)
